subject: Discovery handoff & acceptance checkpoint — OptimizeAI pilot
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@optimizeai.com>, Priya Desai <priya@optimizeai.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-20T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Recap: Discovery + proposed pilot scope (OptimizeAI)

Hi Amir / Priya — thanks for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

High-level pain and goals you shared:
- Search reranking produces inconsistent relevance for short queries (esp. product codes) — precision drop ~18% vs. expectation.
- Summarization hallucinations on finance notes impacting downstream decisioning.
- Current cost/latency: average inference latency ~320ms, cost per 1k tokens higher than target.
- Compliance: need auditability for PII masking and a clear data retention policy for logs.

Pilot proposal (4 weeks, targeted scope):
1) Scope: search reranking + concise meeting-summary pipeline (ingest -> prompts -> post-process).
2) Success metrics: P95 latency on the two flows <= 150ms; rerank NDCG uplift of >= 12% on your labeled set; reduction in per-query token cost by ~40% via batching/quantization strategies.
3) Ownership: Rafael (commercial lead), Aditya Rao (solutions engineer — infra/access), Marcus Lin (ML evaluation & prompt owner).
4) Deliverables: pilot charter, eval prompt set, sample dataset ingest, weekly checkpoints, and a 1-page acceptance checklist at the end of week 4.

Ask from OptimizeAI to start: sample dataset (5–10k anonymized queries + relevance labels), a staging API key or access to sandbox logs, and the security/compliance contacts for the questionnaire.

Scheduling: propose kickoff next Tuesday (2026-12-22) for a 30–45m alignment + access review. If that works, we will send a calendar invite with the agenda.

Attachments: optimizeai-pilot-charter-v1.pdf (pilot scope & metrics), SOW-draft.docx (commercial/redlines).

Next steps (proposed):
- Amir/Priya: confirm kickoff date and share sample data + security contact.
- Aditya: confirm access checklist and required onboarding credentials.
- Marcus: prepare initial eval template and prompt suite.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Amir Khan <amir.khan@optimizeai.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@optimizeai.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-20T17:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + proposed pilot scope (OptimizeAI)

Thanks Rafael — useful recap. Quick responses:
- We’re aligned on scope (rerank + summaries).
- We can provide a 7k-row anonymized sample and relevance labels by EOD Monday (2026-12-21).
- SOC2 documentation and our security point of contact (Maya R.) will send over the questionnaire — please expect security-questionnaire.pdf from our team.

One ask: legal wants a short SOW and a non-prod data processing addendum before we exchange any sandbox logs. We can sign a DocuSign for the SOW if you can push a final version.

Kickoff on 2026-12-22 works for us; any chance for a 10–15m pre-kickoff call the morning of to confirm access steps?

— Amir
Amir Khan
Head of Engineering | OptimizeAI
amir.khan@optimizeai.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@optimizeai.com>, Priya Desai <priya@optimizeai.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-21T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + proposed pilot scope (OptimizeAI)

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Amir. A couple of operational notes before kickoff: 

1) SOW: we uploaded the SOW-draft.docx and pushed a DocuSign link — https://app.docusign.com/some/DocuSignLinkForSOW/OPT-2026-2321. If legal can review and route back with redlines by EOD Monday we’ll aim to have DocuSign completed the same day.

2) Access & data: Aditya — see the sample/data checklist below (I’ve also shared a Drive folder for prompt/eval collaboration): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-optimizeai-pilot

Required for sandbox onboarding:
- Sample dataset (CSV) + label mapping file (CSV)
- Staging API key or read-only log export (S3 or shared GCS)
- Service account with minimal IAM for ingestion (if applicable)
- Security contact for questionnaire (Maya R.)

3) Timeline (draft):
- Tue 12/22: Kickoff + access review (30 min)
- Week 1 (12/22–12/26): data ingest + baseline run + initial prompt drafts
- Week 2 (12/27–1/2): optimization (batching, quant profiles) + mid-pilot check-in
- Week 3 (1/3–1/9): eval runs, metric tuning, smoothing
- Week 4 (1/10–1/16): acceptance run + deliverables and final checklist

If that timeline looks tight given holidays, we can shift start by one week — let me know.

Rafael

Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + proposed pilot scope (OptimizeAI) — access checklist

Rafael / Marcus — quick ops checklist and estimates for onboarding (so we can confirm the pre-kickoff 10–15m):
- I’ll need: sample CSV + label mapping, preferred S3 bucket path or a temporary Google Cloud bucket.
- If they provide a staging API key, we’ll validate with a smoke run (takes ~2–3 hours).
- Service account creation + IAM: customer does, we provide required roles — plan 1 business day for creation.
- Baseline run to capture current latency/cost metrics: ~half day once access is available.

Edge notes: if the dataset contains PII we must enable our masking pipeline before any log ingestion — that’s an extra 1 day for config.

I’ll join the pre-kickoff call on 12/22 at 9:15am PT if that fits; Marcus, can you confirm you’ll have the eval template ready?

Thanks — Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + proposed pilot scope (OptimizeAI) — eval ownership

Thanks — I’ll own the prompt/eval suite and run the acceptance checks. Deliverables/commitments:
- Eval template (attached: eval-template.csv) and scoring rubric ready by 12/24.
- Initial baseline runs completed by 12/30 (assuming access by 12/22).
- Weekly status notes in the shared Drive folder; I’ll post the first run results there.

Amir — one ask: can your team include a short sample of false positives you’ve flagged (even a handful of examples) — that helps calibrate the rerank metric thresholds.

See you on the kickoff.

— Marcus
